about.headline: About STDM
about.subheadline: We integrate technology, digital marketing, advertising and specialized equipment so businesses can create, operate and grow with one accountable partner.
about.historyBody: STDM is the commercial brand of SIS Technologies Digital Marketing S.R.L. What began as technology and digital service capabilities evolved into a broader integrator model: helping companies solve problems across software, cloud, marketing, signage and equipment without juggling multiple disconnected vendors.
about.visionBody: To position STDM as the integrator of choice for organizations that need technology, digital and advertising solutions to converge — enabling long-term partnerships and cross-functional value instead of one-off projects.
about.capabilitiesSubtitle: Four business units that work together under one delivery model.

capabilities.technology: Software development, cloud solutions, IT consulting, DevOps, infrastructure, cybersecurity and industrial technology — with installation and support.
capabilities.digital: Digital marketing, paid media, SEO, social media, marketing automation and analytics focused on measurable business outcomes.
capabilities.advertising: Outdoor and indoor advertising, corporate signage and custom projects that strengthen brand visibility in physical spaces.
capabilities.equipment: Large format printers, CNC equipment, digital and interactive displays, plus installation, training, maintenance and technical support.

about.experienceBody: Our team combines software engineering, solution architecture, digital strategy, creative production and operational support. That mix lets us move from strategy to implementation — and stay accountable after go-live.
about.coverageBody: We operate from Costa Rica and serve companies that need a local partner with bilingual communication, practical delivery and an understanding of regional business conditions. Our focus is B2B across retail, manufacturing, construction, education, healthcare, hospitality, professional services and financial institutions.
about.methodologySubtitle: A clear methodology designed for integrated delivery — not unnecessary complexity.

methodology.step1Body: We clarify goals, constraints, stakeholders and success metrics before recommending a path.
methodology.step2Body: We define the right mix across technology, digital, advertising and equipment so every piece supports the business outcome.
methodology.step3Body: We implement with clear milestones, transparent communication and quality standards your team can trust.
methodology.step4Body: We stay available for training, maintenance, iteration and expansion as your needs grow.

about.viewProjects: See our projects and case studies
about.ctaDescription: Request a consultation and tell us how we can help your business.
